about: D1 foundational grammar — generated by design/reference/tokens.py from scripts/yfie/theme.py (the reference stylesheet's custom properties) after the reference implementation of the stress trio. Technology-neutral (CSS custom properties, no framework). Governed by the Design Intent Lock (design/01_FOUNDATIONS.md §4): values may move at D2+ within the Lock; roles do not.
status: D6 — proven on every one of the 288 documents (the stress trio at D1, the hard families at D2, the synthesis pages at D3, every evidence record and the remaining domain answers at D4, every tool state and journey at D5, every visual contract, portable frame and print form at D6) in English and Arabic at 320–1440 px; every document builds from the same stylesheet (theme.CSS + theme.CSS_D2 + theme.CSS_D6); the D6 block adds no token — the matrix, the dated lanes, the bars, the portable frames and the print system use the D1 roles

fonts.latin: IBM Plex Sans (Light 300, Regular 400, Italic 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600, Bold 700), self-hosted from vendor/fonts/ibm-plex-sans
fonts.arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600, Bold 700), self-hosted from vendor/fonts/ibm-plex-sans-arabic

identity.digits: Western in both languages, as governed copy; numeric runs, IDs and ISO dates isolated left-to-right (bdi) and unbroken

--paper.role: surface of objects and the page

--white.role: surface of figure plates, cards, fields and tables (V1)

--plaster.role: surface of figure insets (white since V1; the institutional band is --green-900)

--ink.role: text; heavy rules at the start of an object

--rule-2.role: hairline in the spine and tables; stems

--ochre.role: rubrics and the figure-group line (from the logo)

--counter.role: the boundary voice and the not-comparable divider (from the logo); the primary green since V1

--green-700.role: primary: links, active navigation, key figures and numerals, primary action (V1)

--green-900.role: deep structure: object and figure rules, chart primary marks, the colophon band (V1)

--sage-600.role: borders of fields and selects; quiet text on paper (V1)

--sage-400.role: decoration only: underlines, chip and tool borders, hairlines (V1; never text)

--sage-100.role: tint panels: what this does not establish, filter bars, table heads (V1)

--brass-700.role: eyebrow labels and the boundary panel's double rule (V1; the value of --ochre)

--brass-300.role: hairlines and ornament only (V1; never text; the value of --ochre-line)

--gold-300.role: accent on --green-900 only: colophon headings and focus (V1)

rules.Arabic rubric: weight and colour only; no letter-spacing, no capitals mimicry

rules.hairline: 1px var(--rule) between answers; 1px var(--rule-2) in the spine and tables
rules.boundary: 3px double var(--counter); on screen since V1 a --sage-100 panel under a 3px double --brass-700 rule
rules.figure inset: 3px solid var(--ink) top on var(--plaster); on screen since V1 a white plate, 1px var(--rule) frame, 3px var(--green-900) top
rules.institutional band: on screen since V1 var(--green-900) with paper text, --gold-300 headings and the logo on a paper tile; print unchanged

space.hit area: ≥40px rows in the index and spine; ≥44px product-bar controls; ≥24px in-flow actions

breakpoints.600: narrow index in two columns; figure lanes side by side; panel-1 row labels beside their tracks
breakpoints.900: spine column (280px) beside the object; product-bar navigation visible; menu hidden; the foot spine hidden
breakpoints.1200: rubric column (220px) beside each answer; spine 300px

focus.visible: 3px double var(--counter), offset 3px; --gold-300 on the colophon (V1)
focus.skip link: first focusable; shown on focus at top-start

motion: none by design; prefers-reduced-motion honoured (no transitions or animations anywhere)

analytical states.observed / reported: value with its governed state label in tables; ● □ ◎ marks keyed by publication, never by colour
analytical states.not comparable: double rule between lanes with the governed label
analytical states.missing: never drawn as zero; no chart invented where a contract has no data

print: product-bar controls, dialog, indexes and footer link groups removed; objects and figures kept whole; the record's disclosure content printed; source locators and the canonical link printed after their text; page breaks avoided inside objects
